desc: Derive the exact contribution formula for a fixed value x, including the number of permutations corresponding to each possible suffix composition.
Group integers 1 through N by decimal digit length and determine the counts for each length.
Design an efficient DP/generating-function computation for the aggregate sum of 10^{suffix digit sum} over possible subsets and suffix orders.
Verify handling of the exclusion of the currently fixed number from its digit-length group.
Derive and assess an insertion recurrence over n using aggregate concatenation statistics.
Implement the modular arithmetic solution in Python with O(N · D) or similarly efficient complexity, where D ≤ 6.
